texts.zh:
一群逃兵与叛徒在[pirate_system.GetName]星系安了家。这些亡命之徒驾驶着偷来并经过改装的舰船从我们的编队中溜走，如今正掠夺着维持我们航程的贸易航线。他们自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并发誓不效忠于任何旗帜。

他们出身于舰队，对我们的舰船、航线和行动模式了如指掌。绝不能任由他们继续壮大。
texts.en:
A band of deserters and renegades has made its home in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. Slipping away from our formation in stolen and modified vessels, these outcasts now prey upon the trade lanes that sustain our journey. They call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and have sworn to answer to no flag.

They are fleet-born, and know our ships, our routes, and our patterns. They must not be allowed to grow any stronger.

label.zh: 警告所有部队，开始安排战舰。
label.en: Alert all commands. Deploy the fleet.

label.zh: 这些不守规矩的人会得到报应。
label.en: These non-conformists will be dealt with.
We should be better than this.

label.zh: 我们不需要海盗这种害群之马。
label.en: Pirates. We don't need that scum.

label.zh: 一定要将他们一网打尽。
label.en: They will be brought to justice.
They must be brought back into the fold.

texts.zh:
太空海盗！即使他们这种想法也令人兴奋，这个自称为[pirate_band.GetName]的团体把目光转向了我们。

虽然我们可以尊重他们选择的生活方式，但这对我们贸易网络产生的影响可不太理想。
texts.en:
Space pirates! Even the thought is a thrill, and a group calling themselves [pirate_band.GetName] have turned their sights on us.

While we can respect their choice of lifestyle, the effect it's having on our trade networks is less ideal.

texts.zh:
一群逃兵与叛徒在[pirate_system.GetName]星系安了家。这些亡命之徒驾驶着偷来并经过改装的舰船从我们的编队中溜走，如今正掠夺着维持我们航程的贸易航线。他们自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并发誓不效忠于任何旗帜。

他们出身于舰队，对我们的舰船、航线和行动模式了如指掌。绝不能任由他们继续壮大。
texts.en:
A band of deserters and renegades has made its home in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. Slipping away from our formation in stolen and modified vessels, these outcasts now prey upon the trade lanes that sustain our journey. They call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and have sworn to answer to no flag.

They are fleet-born, and know our ships, our routes, and our patterns. They must not be allowed to grow any stronger.

texts.zh:
由于觊觎我们恒星系之间不断增长的贸易，一大群源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛教匪徒已经将一些民船非法改造成了战争武器。这些异端自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并对我们在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内的不设防贸易路线发起了数次袭击。

我们不能容忍他们继续这种亵渎行为！
texts.en:
As interstellar trade between our systems continues to grow, a large group of faithless criminals from [Root.Capital.GetName] have illegally converted a number of civilian starships into weapons of war. These heretics have started calling themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and are responsible for several attacks against our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system.

Their profane activities must not be allowed to continue!

texts.zh:
据舰队情报机构报告，在上几个月里，我们境内的民间货船遭到数起袭击。袭击者似乎是源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的逃兵以及其它叛徒。

这些匪徒已经用大幅改装的民船组建了一支临时舰队，并正在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系劫掠我们不设防的贸易路线。他们自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”。尽管他们的舰船非常简陋，但仍是个不可忽略的威胁。
texts.en:
Naval Intelligence has reported several attacks on civilian shipping in our space within the last several months. The perpetrators appear to be deserters and other renegade elements from [Root.Capital.GetName].

These criminals have put together a makeshift space fleet out of heavily modified civilian hulls and are preying on our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. They now call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]." Although crude, their vessels are a clear threat that cannot be ignored.

texts.zh:
我们社会中某些疯狂的不法分子离开了[Root.Capital.GetName]，并在宇宙的偏僻角落里开始亡命生涯。这些歹徒出人意料地手巧，对许多民用飞船进行了大幅改造并武装了起来。

我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内的贸易路线没有设防，并开始遭到这支自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”的简陋舰队的劫掠。我们必须迅速对此做出回应。
texts.en:
Certain irrational and criminal elements of our society have left [Root.Capital.GetName] to seek an outlaw's life in the far reaches of space. In a display of surprising ingenuity, these brigands have heavily modified and weaponized a large number of civilian starships.

Our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system are now being raided by this improvised starfleet, which identifies itself only as the "[pirate_band.GetName]." A prompt response is needed.

texts.zh:
我们的一些商人发来了令人担忧的报告。自从我们发展出太空旅行科技以来，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的边缘群体就不断离开我们的母星，摒弃了我们的和平社会。

这些误入歧途者自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并将数艘民用飞船改造成了战舰。现在他们成了海盗，在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内洗劫我们不设防的贸易路线，他们肆无忌惮的攻击已经造成了许多伤亡。或许有必要采取极端措施来保护我们的人民。
texts.en:
Alarming reports are coming in from some of our traders. Since we developed space travel, violent fringe groups on [Root.Capital.GetName] have departed our homeworld in increasing numbers, spurning the peaceful ways of our society.

These misguided individuals call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and have converted several civilian vessels into warships. Living as pirates, they now prey on our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system and their wanton attacks have led to many deaths. Drastic measures may be needed to protect our people.

texts.zh:
逃离[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛党与歧见者已将数艘民船改造成战舰，组建了一支匪徒舰队。这些恐怖分子自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并正在我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系的不设防贸易路线上散播混乱与恐怖。

这些罪大恶极的匪徒死有余辜。我们必须不惜一切代价恢复秩序。
texts.en:
Rebels and dissidents fleeing from [Root.Capital.GetName] have founded an outlaw space fleet by modifying several civilian vessels into warships. Calling themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]," these terrorists are spreading chaos and fear along our vulnerable trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system.

Their lives have been rendered forfeit by the enormity of their crimes. Order must be restored, at any cost.

texts.zh:
寄生虫永远都会涌向新的市场，企图侵害他人以谋一己之利，在太空中也不例外。[Root.Capital.GetName]上的几个地下犯罪组织已将一小批货船改造成了战舰，将黑手伸向了太空。

这些犯罪分子自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”，而他们的舰船已开始在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内打劫我们不设防的贸易路线。我们应该在事态恶化之前迅速采取行动。
texts.en:
Parasitic elements always flock to new markets, seeking to cut into profits at the expense of those doing honest business - space has proven no different. Several underground criminal organizations on [Root.Capital.GetName] have expanded their operations into space by converting a small fleet of civilian freighters into warships.

The outlaws call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and their ships have started menacing our vulnerable trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. We should act quickly before the situation gets out of hand.

texts.zh:
随着民间太空旅行变得越来越普遍，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的数个强大的犯罪组织也发现了新的机会。他们将一小批民用货船改造成了自制战舰，并用它们来打劫商船的货物。

我们得知他们自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并已在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内数次对我们不设防的贸易路线出手。我们必须尽一切努力，将这些犯罪分子绳之以法。
texts.en:
As civilian travel in space becomes more common place, several powerful criminal organizations on [Root.Capital.GetName] have sensed an opportunity to expand their operations. They have converted a number of civilian freighters into improvised warships, with which they raid civilian shipping lanes for booty.

We know they call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and that they have struck several times against our vulnerable trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. Every effort must be made to bring these criminals to justice.

texts.zh:
由于觊觎我们恒星系之间不断增长的贸易，一大群源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛教匪徒已经将一些民船非法改造成了战争武器。这些异端自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并对我们在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内的不设防贸易路线发起了数次袭击。

Their profane activities must not be allowed to continue!

texts.zh: 很可能黑针鼓励这种非法活动，甚至可能在支持这些投机取巧的私掠者。
texts.en: It is likely that the Black Needle has inspired this illicit activity, and may even be supporting these opportunistic privateers.

label.en: Alert all commands. Deploy the fleet.

They must be brought back into the fold.

texts.zh:
一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的子个体，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内[pirate_system.GetName]星系。

它们打算当海盗来维持自身，利用少数简陋的飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
texts.en:
A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from the Mind's influence, they have established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system, within our space.

From there they intend to sustain themselves by living as pirates, using their small fleet of crude spacecraft to raid the vulnerable trade route that passes through that system.

texts.zh: 一小群故障的单元已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的中枢，并躲进了我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。这些单位已经无可挽回地腐化，并开始利用简陋的舰船劫掠穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
texts.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the [pirate_system.GetName] system, inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft to raid the vulnerable trade route that passes through the system for spare parts and resources.
